name: shoplab
description: ShopLab – training web shop for the web security course. Runs on your own machine only.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
